name: Accurate Background
summary: Accurate Background sells quoted employment screening with county, state, federal and international criminal searches plus a tool called AccurateReach that looks beyond the candidate's address history. Its candidate portal shows required disclosures before a candidate proceeds, and its ATS integrations page lists dozens of partners. No prices are published.

facts.text: The criminal search page lists county, state, federal, civil, sex offender registry and international searches, plus AccurateReach for locations outside the candidate's address history.
The candidate portal page says automated pop-ups make sure candidates see required disclosures and notices before they proceed, and it lists e-signature submission.
The first page of the ATS integrations listing names 37 partners, including Workday, ADP, Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Jobvite and SmartRecruiters, and the list continues on a second page.
The homepage lists no prices and routes buyers to a sales contact page.
